summary: Illustrative compact record with placeholder SHAs. Replace every value with verified review evidence.
limitations: Source reading plus the API's invitation tests; the settings screen was not run in a browser.

story.users: Workspace admins can invite teammates by email; the teammate joins by opening the link and accepting.
story.why: Stated in the issue linked from api #101: admins currently add members by asking support.

matters.text: Deploy the API before the web app: the settings screen calls the new invitation endpoint.
The unique token index must exist before #102 ships; acceptance looks invitations up by token.
Accepting the same invitation twice creates two memberships.

sections.architecture: The settings screen asks the API to invite an email; the API stores an invitation with a random token and sends the link. Opening the link calls the accept endpoint, which creates the membership.
sections.data: A new invitations collection. Memberships gain an optional invitedBy field. Existing memberships are untouched.
sections.rollout: Additive. The unique index is created before #102 deploys.
sections.contracts: Two new API endpoints; no existing response changes.
sections.lifecycle: An invitation is pending, then accepted, revoked or expired after seven days.

decisions.title: Invitations expire after seven days
decisions.why: A forwarded or leaked link should not grant access indefinitely.
decisions.alternatives: Links that never expire were rejected in the issue.

evidence.label: issue, Decisions
evidence.detail: Invitation links expire after seven days.

findings.title: Accepting twice creates two memberships
findings.explanation: Acceptance reads a pending invitation, then creates the membership and marks it accepted without checking it was still pending.
findings.impact: A double click or two open tabs add the same person twice, and the member count and seat billing drift.
findings.scenario: The teammate clicks Accept in two tabs within a second: both requests read status pending, both create a membership.
findings.fix: Claim the invitation with one conditional update: updateOne({ token, status: 'pending' }, { $set: { status: 'accepted' } }) and create the membership only when it modified a document.
